title: Object and Edit Mode - Blender 2.80 Fundamentals
annotator: reference v1: visual inspection by Claude (assistant) from paused browser frames + the user-supplied transcript; human check by Ayesha PENDING
verification_note: Method: the video was played in a normal browser tab at 720p, paused and seeked to these seconds, and the frame was read: 21, 24, 28.5, 34, 40, 44, 48, 52, 55, 57, 59, 61, 63, 65.5, 68, 70.5, 73, 76, 79, 82, 84, 86, 89, 96, 100, 112, 119, 124, 130, 139, 146, 153, 158, 163, 168, 173, 177, 181, 185. The video draws keystroke/mouse overlays (lower left) that were used as evidence. Limits: gaps of 2-7 s between frames (e.g. 91-95, 101-111, 131-138, 164-167), so times are accurate to about +-2-3 s and brief actions between frames may be missed; frames were read by an AI model, not a human; narration timing comes from the user-supplied transcript. Steps marked low confidence are reported separately and are NOT counted in recall denominators. This file is frozen before any experiment output is examined (see the .sha256 file).

steps.goal: Edit Mode is shown in the Modeling workspace and the pointer rests on the mode drop-down (tooltip 'Set the object interaction mode')
steps.after_state: same; tooltip visible at 24 s

steps.goal: Switch between Object Mode and Edit Mode with the mode drop-down
steps.after_state: Object Mode with the Layout workspace at 28.5 s, Edit Mode again at 34 s
steps.note: two frames show different modes plus 'Left Mouse' overlays; the exact mechanism and the workspace change are uncertain

steps.goal: Hotkey Tab toggles between Edit Mode and Object Mode (stated)
steps.after_state: stated only; no Tab overlay seen in this interval

steps.goal: In Edit Mode move (G) the selected geometry to reshape the cube
steps.after_state: cube stretched into a slanted box (40 s, 44 s; overlays 'G', 'Left Mouse G')
steps.note: narration at 33-38 s says you can manipulate vertices, edges and faces; the instructor is concurrently starting the undo-history demonstration

steps.goal: Return to Object Mode (Object Mode visible at 48 s; the key or click that did it was not seen)
steps.after_state: Object Mode (header) at 48 s, overlay 'Ctrl'

steps.goal: Press Ctrl+Z (twice): the cube is restored and Edit Mode comes back
steps.after_state: Edit Mode, regular cube (52 s, overlay 'Ctrl+Z x2')
steps.note: narration 45-55 s explains that edit history and toggling count as undo steps

steps.goal: Press Tab to go back to Object Mode
steps.after_state: Object Mode (55 s, overlay 'Tab')

steps.goal: Press Ctrl+Z: undoing returns into Edit Mode with the edit history intact
steps.after_state: Edit Mode (57 s and 59 s, overlay 'Ctrl + Z')

steps.goal: In Edit Mode select vertices (Shift+click) and move (G) or rotate (R) them to turn the cube into a random shape
steps.after_state: irregular shape (63 s to 70.5 s; overlays 'Left Mouse G' repeated, 'Shift + Left Mouse', 'G R')
steps.note: narration 58.9-68.5 s: 'change this cube into a random shape by selecting one or multiple vertices and using the transformation tools'

steps.goal: Press Tab to toggle back into Object Mode
steps.after_state: Object Mode (73 s, overlay 'Tab')

steps.goal: Rotate the object in Object Mode with R (trackball), several times
steps.after_state: mesh rotated (overlays 'R x2' at 76 s, 'R x3' at 79 s; redo panel 'Trackball')
steps.note: narration 73-77 s: 'let's rotate our cube to add an action in object mode as well'

steps.goal: Press Ctrl+Z repeatedly to step back through the history; the mesh returns toward the cube and Edit Mode comes back
steps.after_state: Edit Mode and a near-original cube (overlays 'Ctrl + Z x2' at 84 s, 'x8' at 86 s, 'x21' at 89 s)
steps.note: narration 77-90 s: 'simply hit control Z to undo ... our edit mode undo history is still intact'

steps.goal: Click the camera to select it (non-mesh objects such as cameras and lights have no Edit Mode)
steps.after_state: camera highlighted (96 s, overlay 'Left Mouse x2')

steps.goal: Add an object with Shift+A and move it (G)
steps.after_state: a small new object above the cube at 100 s; what was added is unclear

steps.goal: Armature: press Tab to enter its Edit Mode and rotate (R) bones
steps.after_state: bones visible and posed at 112 s, overlay 'Tab R'
steps.note: narration 98-112 s says armatures, curves and lattices have an Edit Mode

steps.goal: Duplicate the cube with Shift+D to get a second cube
steps.after_state: two cubes (119 s, overlay 'Shift + D')
steps.note: NOT narrated: the speech at this time is about editing multiple objects; a pure setup action

steps.goal: Select both cubes (click, Shift+click) and enter Edit Mode
steps.after_state: both selected (124 s, overlays 'Left Mouse', 'Shift + Left Mouse'), Edit Mode by 130 s
steps.note: narration 2:00-2:06 'select all the objects you would like to edit and go into edit mode'

steps.goal: In Edit Mode with both cubes, select vertices of either cube and move them (G)
steps.after_state: vertices of both objects editable at once (130 s overlays 'Left Mouse x2', 'Shift + Left Mouse', 'G')

steps.goal: Press F (fill) repeatedly to connect vertices of the two objects; nothing connects
steps.after_state: no edge created across objects (overlays 'F x6' at 139 s, 'F x5' at 146 s, 'F x28' at 153 s)

steps.goal: In Object Mode select both objects and choose Object > Join
steps.before_state: Object Mode, both cubes selected (158 s, 163 s)
steps.after_state: joined mesh (not directly seen: the Object menu was not captured)

steps.goal: Alternative: press Ctrl+J to join the selected objects (stated)
steps.after_state: stated only; no Ctrl+J overlay seen at 163 s or 168 s

steps.goal: Back in Edit Mode select a part of the mesh with Shift+click
steps.after_state: Edit Mode with a selection (173 s overlays 'Left Mouse', 'Shift + Left Mouse', 'Shift')

steps.goal: Open the Mesh menu, then Separate, then choose Selection
steps.after_state: Mesh menu open (177 s); Separate submenu with Selection / By Material / By Loose Parts (181 s)

steps.goal: The selected geometry becomes a new, separate object
steps.after_state: two separate objects (185 s, overlay 'Left Mouse x2')
